
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在自动化处理 PPT 模板、批量整理幻灯片、动态调整页面顺序的场景中，经常需要对幻灯片本身做管理操作：新增、删除、复制、显示 / 隐藏。本文基于 Free Spire.Presentation for .NET 免费库介绍如何完成这些灯片页面管理相关操作，无需 Office 依赖。</span></p>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; font-size: 0.95em; overflow: auto; border-left: 3px solid rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 12px 20px; margin: 1em 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">免费版可以用于 PPT/PPTX 的创建与修改，但需注意在读写文档时幻灯片总数不能超过 10 页，适合中小体量场景。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境配置与核心对象</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 NuGet 安装：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">dotnet add package FreeSpire.Presentation
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">命名空间为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Spire.Presentation</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。幻灯片管理围绕两个核心类型展开：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Presentation</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是整个演示文稿的入口，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Presentation.Slides</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是幻灯片集合，集合中的每一项是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ISlide</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。所有增、删、复制、重排操作最终都落在这个集合上。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Presentation</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 实现了 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">IDisposable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，涉及文件读写时建议用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">using</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 声明，确保句柄及时释放。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">新增幻灯片</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">实例化 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Presentation</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 时，库会自动附带一张空白幻灯片。如果要从零开始构建，先移除这张默认页：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">var</span> ppt = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> Presentation();
ppt.Slides.RemoveAt(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>);
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">之后有两种添加方式：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">ppt.Slides.Append();    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 在末尾追加一张空白幻灯片</span>
ppt.Slides.Insert(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>);   <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 在索引 1 处插入空白幻灯片（索引从 0 起）</span>
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Append()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 不带参数时追加空白页，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Insert(index)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 同样是插入空白页，二者都不会带入任何已有内容。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">删除幻灯片</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">按索引或对象引用删除：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">ppt.Slides.RemoveAt(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>);           <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 按索引删除</span>
ISlide target = ppt.Slides[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>];
ppt.Slides.Remove(target);        <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 按对象引用删除</span>
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">删除前应校验 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ppt.Slides.Count &gt; index</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，避免越界。如果要批量删除，必须倒序遍历：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">int</span> i = ppt.Slides.Count - <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>; i &gt;= <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>; i--)
{
    <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (ShouldDelete(ppt.Slides[i]))
        ppt.Slides.RemoveAt(i);
}
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">正序循环中调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">RemoveAt</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 会导致后续元素的索引前移，出现漏删或越界。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">复制幻灯片</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">复制通过向 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Append</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 或 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Insert</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 传入一个已有的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ISlide</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象来完成，布局、图片和格式会被保留。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">同一文档内复制：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">ISlide source = ppt.Slides[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>];
ppt.Slides.Append(source);      <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 复制到末尾</span>
ppt.Slides.Insert(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, source);   <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 复制并插入到索引 2</span>
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">跨文档复制不需要额外转换，直接把源文档的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ISlide</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 传入目标文档的集合即可：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">var</span> sourcePpt = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> Presentation();
sourcePpt.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"source.pptx"</span>);
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">var</span> targetPpt = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> Presentation();<br>
targetPpt.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"target.pptx"</span>);</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">ISlide toCopy = sourcePpt.Slides[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>];<br>
targetPpt.Slides.Insert(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>, toCopy);<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">从代码形态上看，“复制”与“插入空白页”的区别仅在于 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Insert</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的第二个参数是否为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ISlide</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">隐藏幻灯片</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ISlide</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 暴露了布尔属性 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Hidden</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，用于控制在放映时是否跳过该幻灯片：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">ppt.Slides[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>].Hidden = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;   <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 隐藏第 2 张</span>
ppt.Slides[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>].Hidden = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 取消隐藏</span>
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">隐藏行为与 PowerPoint 中的语义一致：放映时跳过，编辑视图中仍然可见、可编辑。隐藏不改变 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Slides</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 集合的结构，因此批量设置时不需要倒序遍历。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以上 API 覆盖了幻灯片页面层面最常用的管理操作：新增、删除、复制、隐藏。适合用来做 PPT 页面批量整理、模板动态分页、按需控制放映页面等自动化场景。</span></p></section>

</div>
